intro.zh: 插件在 plugin.json 的 permissions 中声明需要的能力。宿主只按声明逐项授权；未声明的能力一律拒绝，撤销（封禁）后即使系统仍授予也会被拒绝。
intro.en: Plugins declare required capabilities in permissions inside plugin.json. The host grants only declared items; undeclared capabilities are always denied, and a revoked (blocked) permission stays denied even if the system still grants it.

description.zh: 读取共享外部存储（/storage/emulated/0/）中的文件。授予后插件可以用原路径读取；未授予时只能访问自己的 data/ 沙箱。
description.en: Read files in shared external storage (/storage/emulated/0/). When granted, plugins may read by original path; otherwise only their own data/ sandbox is accessible.

description.zh: 在共享外部存储中创建、修改、删除文件。Android 11 及以上由宿主的「所有文件访问」统一授权，请只在信任的插件上开启。
description.en: Create, modify or delete files in shared external storage. On Android 11 and above this is granted through the host all-files access; enable it only for trusted plugins.

description.zh: 宿主级特殊权限，需在系统设置中手动开启。开启后读写存储的插件才能真正落到 /storage/emulated/0/ 的原路径。
description.en: Host-level special permission that must be enabled manually in system settings. Only after it is enabled can storage plugins really operate on original paths under /storage/emulated/0/.

description.zh: 发起 HTTP 请求、下载文件、解析域名。插件页面的外部资源加载也受此约束。
description.en: Make HTTP requests, download files and resolve domains. Loading external resources in plugin pages is also covered.

description.zh: 判断当前是否联网、连接类型与 IP 地址。
description.en: Check connectivity, connection type and IP address.

description.zh: 读取 Wi-Fi 开关、SSID 等状态信息。
description.en: Read Wi-Fi state such as enabled status and SSID.

description.zh: 拍照或录制视频。首次使用时系统会单独弹窗询问。
description.en: Take photos or record video. The system asks separately on first use.

description.zh: 录制音频。授权后插件可在前台或后台录音，请谨慎开启。
description.en: Record audio. Once granted the plugin may record in foreground or background; enable with care.

description.zh: 通过 GPS 等获得精确经纬度。
description.en: Obtain precise coordinates through GPS and similar sources.

description.zh: 通过基站与 Wi-Fi 获得粗略位置。
description.en: Obtain a coarse location from cell towers and Wi-Fi.

description.zh: 应用不在前台时也能获取位置，通常需要到系统设置中单独允许。
description.en: Access location while the app is not in the foreground; usually needs a separate system setting.

description.zh: 直接发起通话，不经过拨号界面确认。
description.en: Place calls directly without confirmation in the dialer.

description.zh: 读取设备标识、运营商、通话状态等信息。
description.en: Read device identifiers, carrier and call state.

description.zh: 直接发送短信，可能产生费用。
description.en: Send SMS directly; charges may apply.

description.zh: 读取短信内容与验证码，敏感度高。
description.en: Read SMS content and verification codes; highly sensitive.

description.zh: 监听新到短信。
description.en: Listen for incoming SMS.

description.zh: 读取通讯录姓名、电话与邮箱。
description.en: Read contact names, phone numbers and email addresses.

description.zh: 新增、修改或删除通讯录条目。
description.en: Add, modify or delete contact entries.

description.zh: 读取日历事件与提醒。
description.en: Read calendar events and reminders.

description.zh: 新增、修改或删除日历事件。
description.en: Add, modify or delete calendar events.

description.zh: 在其他应用上方绘制内容，需在系统设置中单独允许。
description.en: Draw over other apps; must be allowed separately in system settings.

description.zh: 修改亮度、铃声等系统设置，需在系统设置中单独允许。
description.en: Change system settings such as brightness and ringtone; must be allowed separately.

description.zh: 在通知栏显示消息（Android 13 及以上需要运行时授权）。
description.en: Show notifications (runtime grant required on Android 13 and above).

description.zh: 触发振动反馈。
description.en: Trigger vibration feedback.

description.zh: 保持 CPU 或屏幕唤醒，可能增加耗电。
description.en: Keep the CPU or screen awake; may increase battery use.

description.zh: 关闭其他应用的后台进程。
description.en: Stop background processes of other apps.

description.zh: 读取系统日志，可能包含其他应用的信息。
description.en: Read system logs, which may contain data from other apps.

description.zh: 拉起安装界面安装 APK，需在系统设置中单独允许。
description.en: Open the installer for APK files; must be allowed separately in system settings.

description.zh: 读取各应用的使用时长与启动记录，需在系统设置中单独允许。
description.en: Read app usage time and launch history; must be allowed separately in system settings.

description.zh: 读取屏幕内容并模拟操作，权限极高，请只授予完全信任的插件。
description.en: Read screen content and simulate actions; extremely powerful, grant only to fully trusted plugins.

description.zh: 读取系统剪贴板内容。属于插件自定义权限，只需声明，无需系统授权。
description.en: Read system clipboard content. A plugin-defined permission: declaration is enough, no system grant.

description.zh: 向系统剪贴板写入内容。属于插件自定义权限，只需声明，无需系统授权。
description.en: Write to the system clipboard. A plugin-defined permission: declaration is enough, no system grant.

description.zh: 开关相机闪光灯。
description.en: Turn the camera flashlight on or off.

description.zh: 连接蓝牙设备。
description.en: Connect to Bluetooth devices.

description.zh: 扫描并管理蓝牙连接。
description.en: Scan and manage Bluetooth connections.

description.zh: 读写 NFC 标签。
description.en: Read and write NFC tags.

description.zh: 以超级用户身份执行命令，仅对已 Root 的设备有效。
description.en: Run commands as superuser; only effective on rooted devices.

description.zh: 通过 Shizuku 借用系统权限执行操作。
description.en: Perform privileged operations through Shizuku.

description.zh: 通过 Dhizuku 借用设备所有者权限。
description.en: Use device-owner privileges through Dhizuku.

notes.zh: 撤销（封禁）只在插件层生效，不会回收系统已授予的权限；需要彻底收回时请到系统设置中关闭。
notes.en: Revoking (blocking) takes effect only inside the plugin layer; it does not take back a system-granted permission. Use system settings to revoke completely.

notes.zh: 用插件打开外部存储文件时，请确认已授予该插件读取和修改此文件的权限，否则插件可能只能看到路径却读不到内容。
notes.en: When opening a file in external storage with a plugin, make sure the plugin has permission to read and modify that file; otherwise it may see the path but fail to read the content.

notes.zh: 特殊权限（所有文件访问、悬浮窗、修改系统设置、安装应用、使用情况访问、无障碍等）无法由宿主直接弹窗授予，需要到系统设置中手动开启。
notes.en: Special permissions (all files access, display over other apps, modify system settings, install apps, usage access, accessibility and similar) cannot be granted by a host dialog; enable them manually in system settings.
